name: Sales_Returns_Form
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 Sales Returns status chain (Delivery 07 §1, RT-R1/R3/R6). server/modules/delivery-management/sales-returns.mjs computes Return_Status from the linked pullout appointment and this form's own received/credit-note fields — it never replaces the existing Sales_Order/Item_Details/RMA/Books_SalesReturn_No fields the widget already reads.

fields.name: Source_SA_ID
fields.label: Source Service Appointment
fields.helpText: RT-R1: the delivery appointment a refused line came from, if this return started that way. Blank for a manual/complaint-driven return.

fields.name: Pullout_Appointment_ID
fields.label: Pullout Appointment
fields.helpText: RT-R1/R2: the Service_Appointment (Type_of_Delivery = Pullout) created to collect the goods. Server-only.

fields.name: Received_Condition
fields.label: Received Condition
fields.helpText: RT-R3: set when the warehouse receiver confirms the return.

fields.name: Return_Status
fields.label: Return Status
fields.helpText: RT-R6, computed server-only. 'closed' follows 'credit_note_issued' immediately — this app has no separate closing action for a return once the credit note exists.
